blocked.title: Remote Access isn't available on Fire TV devices
blocked.body: Fire OS blocks the accessibility features a technician needs to control your device. We can still help you through a support ticket instead.

notNative.paid: ✅ Your remote session is paid and ready. You're viewing this in a web browser — the technician setup runs inside the app.
notNative.paidNext: On the box that needs help, open the <1>Snow Media Center app</1> (not a browser) and go to Support → Remote Access. Your paid request will pick up automatically — nothing to re-enter.
notNative.unpaid: You're viewing this in a web browser. The technician setup runs inside the Snow Media Center <1>app</1> — on the box that needs help, open the app itself and go to Support → Remote Access.

noauth.body: Sign in to your Snow Media account to request a Remote Access session. Use the Sign In button on the Home screen, then come back here.

form.subtitle: Tell us what's wrong — a technician takes control of your box and fixes it with you. {{price}} per session.
form.issuePlaceholder: e.g. Live TV buffers every few minutes on all channels
form.needsLabel: What do you need me to do? <1>(optional)</1>
form.needsPlaceholder: e.g. Check my settings and get the streams playing smoothly

pay.title: Pay for your session
pay.subtitle: Request saved. Pay on your phone — no typing card numbers with the remote.
pay.scan: Scan the QR code with your phone to pay {{price}}. This screen moves on by itself the moment your payment arrives.
pay.codeLabel: Have a code from Snow Media?
pay.codeHint: Type it here and the payment step is skipped.
pay.dialogDesc: Scan with your phone to pay for the remote support session. This screen continues automatically once payment arrives.
pay.guestBody: You can pay as a guest — no account needed. Finish the payment on your phone and this screen will continue on its own.

app.title: Install the Support app
app.body: The Snow Support app is what shares your screen with the technician. Install it, press Recheck, and this step turns Done.

overlay.title: Allow "Display over other apps"
overlay.why: This permission is what draws the technician's pointer on your screen.
overlay.how: A list of apps opens — find <1>Snow Support</1> and turn on <1>"Allow display over other apps"</1>. Then come back and confirm.

a11y.title: Turn on the Snow Support accessibility service
a11y.why: This is what lets the technician's clicks actually press things on your box.
a11y.how: Find <1>Snow Support</1> in the list and switch it <1>On</1>. Then come back and confirm.
a11y.important: <1>Important:</1> step 2 (Display over other apps) must be Done first — turning this on before the overlay permission can leave the remote unresponsive until the box is unplugged.

ready.title: You're all set
ready.subtitle: What happens next
ready.point1: The technician can see your screen and control your box.
ready.point2: A red border stays on screen the whole time so you always know it's active.
ready.point3: You can end the session whenever you want.

started.title: Session started
started.body1: The Snow Support app is open and takes it from here — it shows a 6-digit code and asks you to confirm screen sharing.
started.body2: Give the code to your technician and accept the prompt. Remember: the red border means the session is live, and you can end it anytime.

toast.saveFailedDesc: Check your internet connection and try again.
toast.readyDesc: Let's get your box ready for the technician.
toast.codeInvalid: That code isn't right. Check it and try again.
toast.codeUsedUp: That code has already been used.
toast.codeTooMany: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
toast.codeNoRequest: This request is not waiting for payment any more.
toast.codeSignedOut: Sign in to use a code.
toast.notYetDesc: It can take a minute after checkout. Keep this screen open.
toast.installFailedDesc: Could not install the Support app.
toast.overlayManual: Open Android Settings → Apps → Special app access → Display over other apps manually.
toast.startFailedDesc: Open the Snow Support app from your apps list instead.
